decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans 1031/10 received 4th October 2010  therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is used.

Condition : 2 - The approved outbuilding shall only be used for purposes incidental to the enjoyment of the existing dwelling on the site and shall not be used as separate living accommodation or for business purposes.
Condition : 3 - No additional windows shall be formed in the walls of the outbuilding hereby approved without the prior written consent of the Local Planning Authority.
Condition : 4 - The side and rear walls of the outbuilding shall be rendered and white washed within three months from the date of this permission and permanently maintained as such.
description: Retrospective application for the erection of a detached outbuilding in the rear end of the garden to the house
